newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Silver Grant in HK$480 mln shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Silver Grant in HK$480 mln shr placement.

text.p: Silver Grant International Industries Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to raise a net proceed of HK$480 million through a placing of 130.72 million new shares to controlling shareholder Join Truth Ltd.

The company said Join Truth had agreed to place through placing agents a total of 130.72 million existing Silver Grant shares at HK$3.75 each before it subscribed the same amount of new shares at a net placing price after expenses.
On completion of deal, Join Truth's stake in Silver Grant will be diluted to 44.9 percent from the current 53.9 percent.

Among the HK$480 million net proceeds raised from the new issue, HK$116 million will contribute to Silver Grant's 50 percent interest in Beijing Wang Fu Jiang Retail Management Co Ltd (BWFJ), the statement said.
It said HK$161 million would contribute to the company's 50 percent share in the shareholders loan of BWFJ for the purpose of buying a shopping mall in Wuhan in China.

Another HK$152 million will contribute to the company's 40 percent interest in the registered capital of China Infra-Structure Investment Ltd and the remaining HK$51 million for working capital, it said.
Silver Grant shares ended at HK$3.925 on Monday.
